title: Stored Snapshot (Payload)
description: A vitals snapshot as stored, with server-side analysis. Stored as JSON payload inside vitals_snapshot.payload. Contains the raw HealthKit reading and the server's textual analysis.

receivedAt.description: ISO 8601. Server timestamp when the snapshot was received.

snapshot.description: The raw health reading from the iOS client.

analysis.description: Server-computed textual analysis. Keys are metric names, values are human-readable strings.
